author: Xyla Foxlin
description:
URGENT! If you support the Mental Health in Aviation Act, we need your help IMMEDIATELY. Senator Duckworth is a crucial member of the Transportation Committee, and we need her support to get the MHAA through Senate Committee markup on Wednesday. This is the MOST CRITICAL STEP for the MHAA to either move under unanimous consent or go to vote on the Senate floor. Please call Senator Duckworth's office at (202) 224-2854 and let her know that this bill is crucial for addressing the pilot mental health crisis, which is a risk to every single American. If you'd like a script you can read verbatim, please see the one I've included here:

“Hi, my name is __ and I am a [pilot/ATC/concerned member of the flying public] (if a resident of Illinois: “and a constituent”). I am asking Senator Duckworth to support the Mental Health in Aviation Act. title: URGENT HELP NEEDED! The MHAA is going into Senate Committee markup on WEDNESDAY!
